# SpeechRecognitionManager

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Speech/SpeechRecognitionManager.cs#L39)

The speech recognition module. Loads an offline model, listens to a
[`SpeechAudioInput`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechAudioInput) and turns what it hears into text. Deciding what that text
means belongs to [`SpeechPhrase`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechPhrase), not here. Registers itself as
[`ISpeechRecognitionService`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ISpeechRecognitionService).

Recognition runs on a worker thread, because decoding a second of audio takes longer than
a frame. Audio goes in through a queue and results come back through another; nothing
touches Unity's API off the main thread.

```csharp
public class SpeechRecognitionManager : VRModule, ISpeechRecognitionService
```

### StartListening() {#startlistening}

Starts feeding audio to the recogniser. Does nothing while [`CanListen`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ISpeechRecognitionService#canlisten) is
false, so a scene may call it before the model has finished loading.


### OnPartialResult {#onpartialresult}

The text so far, raised repeatedly as someone speaks and revised as the recogniser
changes its mind. Useful for showing what is being heard, never for deciding anything.

